svg.title: P2WSH address construction
svg.desc: Alice and Bob's 71-byte witness script goes through SHA256 to give a 32-byte script hash, which becomes the witness program. A Bech32 bracket groups prepending witness version 0, regrouping into 53 values of 5 bits, calculating a 6-value checksum over bc and those values, appending it, and writing bc1 followed by one character per value, which gives a 62-character address beginning with bc1q.

text.tspan: Alice and Bob's witness script, 71 bytes
Write bc1, then one character per value
